headlines.headline: DUKE TOPS PRESEASON POWER 44 AS PROGRAMS RAMP UP TOWARD MIDNIGHT MADNESS
headlines.detail: Arizona, coming off a 36-win season and its first Final Four since 2001, has scheduled its Midnight Madness-style kickoff event for Sept. 26.

headlines.headline: DOJ OPENS CRIMINAL PROBE INTO CLIPPERS OVER ALLEGED KAWHI LEONARD SPONSORSHIP SCHEME
headlines.detail: Reported potential penalties under discussion include a steep franchise fine and lost future first-round picks, though nothing has been finalized. Portland separately acquired Ja Morant from Memphis.

headlines.headline: MAHOMES, CHIEFS HOST COLTS IN SUNDAY NIGHT PRIMETIME AFTER DOMINANT WEEK 1
headlines.detail: Kansas City is a 6.5-point favorite hosting Indianapolis Sunday, Sept. 20, 8:20 PM ET (NBC), after the Colts opened 0-1 with a home loss to Baltimore.

headlines.headline: NO. 2 GEORGIA VISITS ARKANSAS HEADLINES A LOADED WEEK 3 SLATE
headlines.detail: Also Saturday: No. 5 Miami at Wake Forest, No. 13 Texas Tech vs. No. 22 Houston, and Arizona State vs. Kansas in London.
